
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /improve  (/-)                             │
  │  Improvement Feedback                       │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Mark the last response for improvement (negative feedback).

  Usage:
    /improve
    /-

  Details:
    Records that the last response could be better. RadSim uses this
    alongside positive feedback to learn what works and what doesn't.

  Examples:
    $ /improve
    $ /-

  Related: /good  /stats
